gui.alquimia.stir.tooltip: Hold to stir: the mixture moves along the pending path. Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.dilute.tooltip: Uses a water bottle from the reagent slot: pulls the mixture toward the center and adds one water level. Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.fix.tooltip: Uses salt: fixes the essence under the mixture. The closer to the essence's center, the stronger. Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.empower.tooltip: Uses sulfur: raises the last fixed essence by one level, but halves its duration. Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.prolong.tooltip: Uses quicksilver: multiplies the duration of all fixed essences by 1.5 (up to 2 times). Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.bottle.tooltip: Fills empty bottles with the elixir: one per water level in the cauldron. Shortcut: %s
gui.alquimia.center.tooltip: Center the map on the mixture and follow it. Shortcut: %s

gui.alquimia.empty.confirm: Shift + click to empty the cauldron
gui.alquimia.help.short: Hover the «?» to see how to brew an elixir
gui.alquimia.help.tooltip:
How to brew an elixir:
1. Fill the cauldron with water and put it over a fire.
2. Put ingredients in the leaf slot: each one adds a path (black line).
3. Hold «Stir» to move the mixture.
4. Over an essence, put salt in the reagent slot and press «Fix».
5. Add empty bottles and press «Bottle».
Grind ingredients in a mortar to travel their full path. Avoid the skulls!
